title: cotoneaster distichus var. verruculosus
intro:
Cotoneaster distichus var. verruculosus, commonly known as a plant species within the Rosaceae family, is a type of shrub or small tree that is native to certain regions of the world.

This plant is used for its health benefits, which include being a natural remedy for various digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, due to its anti-inflammatory and astringent properties. The therapeutic actions of Cotoneaster distichus var. verruculosus include its ability to calm the gastrointestinal tract and provide relief from nausea and vomiting. The bioactive constituents present in this plant are still being researched, but it is believed to contain compounds such as tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
